headline: Trump Says US Will End $4 Billion Annual Military Aid to Israel After 2026
summary: US President Donald Trump stated that the United States will end its $4 billion annual military assistance to Israel at the end of 2026, an agreement reached with Prime Minister Netanyahu.
why: Geopolitical shifts in foreign military financing alter sovereign credit risk profiles and regional defense industry dynamics.

impacts.why: Termination of multi-billion dollar military aid impacts sovereign budgetary and defense funding structures.
